question: Which among the following soils is also known as Regur soil?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Black.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Black soil is also known as Regur soil.**
 
• Regur soil is a type of clayey soil that is found in the Deccan Plateau region of India.
